description: Short-lived, non-critical side effects scheduled with after() that run in the current instance via waitUntil() without persistent retry guarantees.
Persisting a job payload to an external message broker or workflow engine before returning the HTTP response so retries survive process restarts.
after() provides at-most-once execution bounded by the instance lifetime, whereas a durable queue provides at-least-once delivery with backoff and dead-letter queues.
An architectural decision record defining how server startup telemetry (register), uncaught error reporting (onRequestError), and post-response tasks (after) are governed.
